_meta.rationale: OpenAI's first-preference display face Soehne resolves to BRAND_FONT_REGISTRY rows keyed 'sohne'/'soehne', both of which carry brand_font_name='Sohne' and free_alternative_name='Inter'. The library renders the free alternative; the disclosure aside surfaces both names. No palette or spacing assertions; those would require a source-of-truth not yet documented for buttons.

assertions.evaluate: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('.a-button'); if (!el) return false; const fam = window.getComputedStyle(el).fontFamily || ''; return fam.toLowerCase().includes('inter'); })()
(() => { const el = document.querySelector('.a-button'); if (!el) return false; return (el.textContent || '').toLowerCase().includes('openai'); })()
